1-2.word_for_word: सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमे तु पुनः शतधनोर्वधे । — In the fifty-seventh century he again killed Śatadhanu; प्राप्तं स्म दुर्यशो मार्ष्टि कृष्णो\ऽक्रूराहृतान्मणेः ॥ — We have obtained the infamous Marshti, the jewel stolen by the cruel Lord Kṛṣṇa.; अक्रूरमुरीकृत्य मणेः पात्रमथा च्युतः । — Then Akrūra turned the vessel into a jewel and dropped it.; उपमन्त्र्य तमेकान्ते सरामो\ऽगाद्रजाह्वयम् ॥ — After inviting him to a secluded place, Sarama went to Rajahvāya.; सत्राजितः श्री-कृष्णाज्ञाभङ्गफलं व्यक्तीकर्तुम् आह---विज्ञातार्थो\ऽपीति । — Satrajit, to express the consequences of breaking the command of Sri Krishna, argues that even the known meaning.; पाण्डवा बिलद्वारेण जतुगृहान्निर्गता इत्य् एवं विज्ञातो\ऽर्थ येन सः कुन्तीं च दग्धामाकर्ण्य कुल्यकरणे कुलोचितसंव्यवहारार्थम् ॥१॥ — The Pāṇḍavas had thus understood the meaning of the fact that they had emerged from the house of Jatu through the door of the cave.; अन्येषां तद्दाहदुःखाभावाद् भीष्मादीन्सङ्गम्येत्य् उक्तम् ॥ — It is said that others, such as Bhīṣma, should associate with the demigods because of the pain of burning them.; २-३ ॥ — 2-3 ॥
1-2.translation: In the fifty-seventh century he again killed Śatadhanu We have obtained the infamous Marshti, the jewel stolen by the cruel Lord Kṛṣṇa. Then Akrūra turned the vessel into a jewel and dropped it. After inviting him to a secluded place, Sarama went to Rajahvāya. Satrajit, to express the consequences of breaking the command of Sri Krishna, argues that even the known meaning. The Pāṇḍavas had thus understood the meaning of the fact that they had emerged from the house of Jatu through the door of the cave. It is said that others, such as Bhīṣma, should associate with the demigods because of the pain of burning them. 2-3 ॥

4.word_for_word: ननु जीवन्सत्राजित्कथं मणिं दास्यति तत्रोचतुः यो\ऽस्मभ्यम् इति । — If so, how could Satrajit give the jewel while he was alive?; भ्रातरं प्रसेनं मृतं कस्मान्नान्वियान्नानुगच्छेत् म्रियताम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥ — When his brother Prasena died, why should he not follow him? This means that he should die.; ४-५ ॥ — 4-5 ॥
4.translation: If so, how could Satrajit give the jewel while he was alive? When his brother Prasena died, why should he not follow him? This means that he should die. 4-5 ॥

13.word_for_word: अपीतो मृतः सप्तदशसङ्ख्याकान् संयुगान् ॥ — Apita died after seventeen battles.; १३-१४ ॥ — 13-14.

15-17.word_for_word: तौ रामकृष्णावेकम् एव तत्त्वम् इत्य् अभिप्रेत्य् आह---य इदम् इति । — He meant that both Rama and Kṛṣṇa are the same essence, and he said, “Who is this?”; अजया मायया मोहिताजयेति सन्धिरार्षः ॥ — The treaty of conquest is deluded by the illusory energy of Ajaya.; १५-१७ ॥ — 15-17.
15-17.translation: He meant that both Rama and Kṛṣṇa are the same essence, and he said, “Who is this?” The treaty of conquest is deluded by the illusory energy of Ajaya. 15-17.

18.word_for_word: अन्तर्यामि-कृष्ण-नियुक्तस् तस्मिन्नक्ररे मणिं न्यस्य ययाव् अपलायत ॥१८॥ — Engaged by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the innermost parts of the body he placed the jewel in the sacrificial fire and fled away
18.translation: Engaged by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the innermost parts of the body he placed the jewel in the sacrificial fire and fled away

19.word_for_word: गुरुः श्वशुरस्तद्धन्तारम् ॥१९॥ — The teacher is the father-in-law and the killer.
19.translation: The teacher is the father-in-law and the killer.

20.word_for_word: शत-योजन-मात्रगामित्वात्ततः परं गन्तुम् अशक्तस् तत्र पतितः तं हयं विसृज्य ॥२०॥ — Having traveled only a hundred yojanas he fell down there leaving behind his horse unable to go beyond that
20.translation: Having traveled only a hundred yojanas he fell down there leaving behind his horse unable to go beyond that

21-22.word_for_word: व्यचिनोन्म गया मास । — Vyachinonm went month.; अक्ररे मणिरस्तीति सर्वज्ञतया विदित्वा\ऽपि रामवञ्चनाय तथा कृतवान् इति भावः ॥२१-२२॥ — This means that although he knew with omniscience that there was a jewel in Akra he did so in order to deceive Rama (21-22).
21-22.translation: Vyachinonm went month. This means that although he knew with omniscience that there was a jewel in Akra he did so in order to deceive Rama (21-22).

24-25.word_for_word: सर्वज्ञस्यैवं विचेष्टितं मद्-वञ्चनायेति मत्वा गूढ-मन्युर् आह---अहम् इति ॥२४-२५॥ — Thinking that the omniscient Lord had thus acted to deceive Me, he said in hidden anger, "I am.
24-25.translation: Thinking that the omniscient Lord had thus acted to deceive Me, he said in hidden anger, "I am.

26.word_for_word: कतिचित् समाः संवत्सरान् प्रासङ्गिम् आह---तत इति ॥२६॥ — A few equal years, he argues in relation to the occasion, saying, "Then.
26.translation: A few equal years, he argues in relation to the occasion, saying, "Then.

27.word_for_word: सत्यभामाम् अप्य् अवञ्चयद् इति सूचयन्न् आह---केशव इति ॥२७॥ — Indicating that he had also deceived Satyabhama, he said, "Kesava.
27.translation: Indicating that he had also deceived Satyabhama, he said, "Kesava.

28.word_for_word: बन्धोः सत्राजितः । — Bandho’s Satrajit.; सपरायिकाः पारलौकि क्यः ॥२८॥ — They are paranoid and transcendental.
28.translation: Bandho’s Satrajit. They are paranoid and transcendental.

29.word_for_word: व्यूषतुर्द्वारकायाः सकाशात् कापि पलायितौ प्रयोजक मणिहरणे शतधन्वनः प्रवर्तकौ तत्राक्रूरः कृष्णानुमतेनैव गतः कृतवर्मा तु भक्तपक्षपातप्राकट्यभयादिवोपेक्षित इति गम्यते कथमन्यथा सर्वज्ञेश्वरवञ्चनं तयोः संभवतीति ॥२९॥ — It is understood that Akrūra went there with the permission of Lord Kṛṣṇa while Kṛtavarma was neglected for fear of revealing the partiality of his devotees. How else could they have deceived the omniscient Lord?
29.translation: It is understood that Akrūra went there with the permission of Lord Kṛṣṇa while Kṛtavarma was neglected for fear of revealing the partiality of his devotees. How else could they have deceived the omniscient Lord?

30-31.word_for_word: तद् एवं वाराणस्यां दानपति-समाख्यया मणि-हस्ते\ऽक्रूरे रुक्म-वेदिकैर् महाध्वरैर् यजमाने निवसति पुनः श्री-कृष्णेनैव प्रस्थापितो\ऽक्रूर इति कर्णे कर्णे जपति जने सत्यभामा-रामादीनाम् अप्य् अविश्वासे जन-सङ्ग्रहायाक्रूरं समाहूय साक्षेपं श्री-कृष्णः प्राह---इदं च — That thus in Varanasi, in the name of Danapati, Mani-haste\'Akrura dwells in the sacrifice of golden altars and great sacrifices. Again, sent by Sri Krishna, he chants in ear to ear, Akrura; भगवन्-मतं सङ्गोप्य केचन ऋषयो\ऽन्यत्-कारणम् अक्रूरानयने वर्णयन्ति तद् यथा-श्रुतं दूषयितुम् अनुवदति अक्रूरे प्रोषित इति ॥३०॥ — Some sages, concealing the opinion of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, describe another reason for bringing Akrura.; दूषयति---इतीति । — It contaminates---it.; अङ्ग हे राजन् । — Ang, O King.; श्री-कृष्णमाहात्म्यं विस्मत्येति तद् एवाह---मुनिवासनिवास इति । — He is amazed at the greatness of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and that is what he calls the abode of the sages.; मुनीनां वासो यस्मिन्स श्री-कृष्णस्तस्य निवासे सत्यक्रूरापगम-मात्रेणारिष्टदर्शनं किं घटेत ? — What can happen to the sight of evil merely by the departure of Satyakrura in the abode of Sri Krishna, in whom the sages reside?; तदिच्छां विना न घटेतेत्य् अर्थः ॥३१॥ — That means that it does not happen without that desire.
30-31.translation: That thus in Varanasi, in the name of Danapati, Mani-haste\'Akrura dwells in the sacrifice of golden altars and great sacrifices. Again, sent by Sri Krishna, he chants in ear to ear, Akrura Some sages, concealing the opinion of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, describe another reason for bringing Akrura. It contaminates---it. Ang, O King. He is amazed at the greatness of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and that is what he calls the abode of the sages. What can happen to the sight of evil merely by the departure of Satyakrura in the abode of Sri Krishna, in whom the sages reside? That means that it does not happen without that desire.

32-34.word_for_word: पुनस्तन्मतम् एवानुवर्णयति---देव इति । — Again, he describes the same view as God.; काशिषु देशेषु देवेमघवत्यवर्षति सति ॥ — When it rained in the regions of Kāśī, the goddess of fortune, Indra, was very pleased.; ३२-३३ ॥ — 32-33.; इत्य् एवम् भूतमक्रूरमहिमप्रतिपादनपरं वृद्धानां वाक्यं श्रुत्वा सत्यम् एवं तथाप्येतावद् एव वारणं न भवति किन्तु मणेर् अप्यपगम इति मत्वेत्येतद्वन्तं परमतम् ॥३४॥ — Thus having heard the words of the elders thus explaining the cruel glory of the being it is true Yet this is not the only way to prevent it but considering it to be the loss of even a jewel this is the supreme conclusion.
32-34.translation: Again, he describes the same view as God. When it rained in the regions of Kāśī, the goddess of fortune, Indra, was very pleased. 32-33. Thus having heard the words of the elders thus explaining the cruel glory of the being it is true Yet this is not the only way to prevent it but considering it to be the loss of even a jewel this is the supreme conclusion.

35.word_for_word: विज्ञातम् अखिलं येन स चासावत एव चित्तज्ञश् च । — He who has known the whole is the same as the Asavata and the knower of the mind.; अयं भावः--- महा-भागवतस्यास्य मया दत्ते\ऽपि मणाव् अपेक्षा नास्त्य् एव यस्माद् आहूतो मणिना सहैवागत इति ज्ञात्वेति ॥ — This means that even though I have given this great devotee of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he has no need of the jewel.; ३५-३६ ॥ — 35-36.
35.translation: He who has known the whole is the same as the Asavata and the knower of the mind. This means that even though I have given this great devotee of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he has no need of the jewel. 35-36.

37.word_for_word: ततः किमत आह---सत्राजित इति । — Then he argues for what, Satrajit.; अपः पिण्डांश् च निनीय दत्त्वा ऋणं च विमुच्यापाकृत्य शेषितमवशिष्टं दायं दुहितुः सत्यभामायाः सुता गृह्णीयुर् इति शास्त्रम् । — The scriptures say that the daughters of Satyabhama, the daughter of the daughter of Satyabhama, should take the remaining payment after bringing the water and the bodies and paying off the debt.; तथा च स्मरति--- — And he remembers; पत्नी दुहितरश् चैव पितरौ भ्रातरस् तथा । — His wife, daughters, fathers and brothers; तत्सुता गोत्रज बन्धुशिष्यसब्रह्मचारिणः ॥ — His daughters were born in a clan, relatives, disciples and celibates.; इति ॥३७॥ — It is said.
37.translation: Then he argues for what, Satrajit. The scriptures say that the daughters of Satyabhama, the daughter of the daughter of Satyabhama, should take the remaining payment after bringing the water and the bodies and paying off the debt. And he remembers His wife, daughters, fathers and brothers His daughters were born in a clan, relatives, disciples and celibates. It is said.

38.word_for_word: अग्रजो\ऽपि न प्रत्येति न विश्वसितीति ॥३८॥ — Even the elder brother does not believe or trust.
38.translation: Even the elder brother does not believe or trust.

39.word_for_word: नास्तीति न वक्तव्यम् यतो\ऽव्युच्छिन्नाः सन्तता मखा वर्तन्त इति ॥३९॥ — It is not to be said that there is none, for the sacrifices are continuous and uninterrupted.
39.translation: It is not to be said that there is none, for the sacrifices are continuous and uninterrupted.

40-41.word_for_word: आलब्ध उक्तो हृदि स्पृष्ट इति वा ॥४०॥ — or attained, said, or touched in the heart.; रजो मिथ्याभिशापं संमृज्य अन्यैर् दुर्धर इत्य्-आदि-मिषेण प्रीत्या भूयस् तस्मै प्रत्यर्पितवान् इति ॥४१॥ — Having wiped away the false curse of Rajas by others he returned them to him with affection by saying 'Durdhara'
40-41.translation: or attained, said, or touched in the heart. Having wiped away the false curse of Rajas by others he returned them to him with affection by saying 'Durdhara'

42.word_for_word: दुष्कीर्ति तन्मूलं दुरितं चेति ॥४२॥ — Bad reputation is the root of that and evil.
42.translation: Bad reputation is the root of that and evil.
